title: NHomes

# 🏠 NHomes — Modern Home Management (1.21+)

![NHomes-LOGO](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ea1c9b8c8aa52e6abda8224c0361743310334d0_0.webp)


**NHomes** is a modern, high-performance home management plugin designed for **Minecraft 1.21+** servers. Built with a strong focus on user experience, it provides beautiful interactive GUIs for Java players and native custom forms for Bedrock (**Geyser/Floodgate**) players.

Whether you run a Survival, SMP, or Creative server, NHomes adds the professional touch your players deserve.

---

## ✨ Key Features

- **🚀 Multi-Platform UI:** Paginated GUIs for Java + native Bedrock Forms for Geyser/Floodgate users.
- **⚡ Folia supported:** Compatible with Folia’s regionalized multithreading and Paper’s latest API.
- **💾 Flexible storage:** Supports **SQLite** for easy setup and **MySQL** for network-wide synchronization.
- **🎨 Visual teleportation:** Customizable countdown/warmup with **BossBars**, **ActionBars**, **Titles**, and **Particle** effects.
- **🛠️ Home editor:** Rename homes, change icons using the item in your hand, and update locations via an intuitive management menu.
- **🔢 Rank-based limits:** Set different home limits using permissions (e.g., VIP, MVP).
- **⌨️ Tab-completion:** Advanced command suggestions for faster usage.

## 🛠️ Commands & Permissions

| Command | Permission | Description |
|---|:---:|---:|
| `/home [name]` | None (Default) | Open the homes menu or teleport to a specific home. |
| `/sethome <name>` | None (Default) | Create a new home at your current location. |
| `/delhome <name>` | None (Default) | Delete an existing home. |
| `/nhomes reload` | `nhomes.admin` | Reload configuration files. |

### Limit permissions

- `nhomes.limit.<group_name>` (e.g., `nhomes.limit.vip`)
- `nhomes.bypass.warmup` (Bypass teleport wait time)

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

NHomes is highly customizable: edit messages, sounds, and every GUI item. The plugin uses **BoostedYAML** to preserve your comments and formatting even after updates.

- `config.yml` — Teleport settings, sounds, and database.
- `messages.yml` — MiniMessage support (gradients + hex colors).
- `gui.yml` — Customize the Java inventory layout.
- `forms.yml` — Tailor the Bedrock user experience.

---

## 📥 Installation

- Download `NHomes.jar`.
- Drop it into your server’s `plugins/` folder.
- (Optional) Install **Floodgate** for Bedrock support.
- Restart your server and enjoy!
